title: Providing and furnishing interior wood work and furniture including wall paneling etc for New Inspection Quarters at Pulicat Lighthouse cum DGNSS Station
summary: Two-cover percentage-rate e-tender for interior wood work, wall panelling and furniture for the new inspection quarters at Pulicat Lighthouse and DGNSS station, Tiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Pulicat Lighthouse cum DGNSS Station, Pulicat, Tiruvallur Dist, Tamilnadu (new inspection quarters)
sites.work: Interior wood work, wall panelling and furniture for new inspection quarters

scope.item: Providing and furnishing interior wood work and furniture including wall paneling etc for new inspection quarters

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1). EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, with MoU between professional agencies having business registration, PAN, GST and similar experience in interior wood works/wall panelling/furniture from reputed firm
Similar works in last seven years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% simple interest

Similar works: interior wood work, wall panelling and furniture work / repairs and civil maintenance or construction of buildings/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work for Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies/reputed firms
CA-certified average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2024

Key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); non-blacklisting affidavit; relatives list; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII)
notes: NIT Section I only; no BOQ or furniture schedule. Download/submission 12.09.2024 (10:00) to 03.10.2024 (15:00); opening 04.10.2024 15:00. Station listed as DGNSS station; matched to Pulicat Lighthouse and DGPS Station.
